changes.title: Choose the branch a thread's work goes into
changes.body: Pick it with "into main" in the Git status panel: the changes, Merge main in and the pull request follow it.

changes.title: Threads and chats open at once
changes.body: No more waiting to sync after an update: your threads are there at once, and a chat opens on its latest messages, loading the earlier ones as you scroll up.

changes.title: Edit your last message
changes.body: Change what you sent and the agent starts over from there, with the files its reply changed put back.

changes.title: Open a thread in your editor or terminal
changes.body: Your editors, terminals and Finder sit in the top bar and open in the thread's folder.

changes.title: Steer the agent while it works
changes.body: Send now and ⌘↵ give Claude or Codex your message at its next step instead of stopping it.

changes.title: An API for programs on your Mac
changes.body: Once you allow them, other programs can list and start threads, send messages and follow along, also over MCP; manage them in Settings › Ensemble API.

changes.title: Codex's newest models in the model menu
changes.body: GPT-6.1-Sol, GPT-6-Astra and the others Codex offers today, instead of GPT-5.5 alone.

changes.title: See how much of your Codex plan is used
changes.body: For ChatGPT sign-ins, your computer's own included, beside Claude's in the usage popover and in Settings.

changes.title: Side-by-side diffs
changes.body: Old and new side by side, unchanged lines folded, and only the words that changed marked.

changes.title: Replies start right away
changes.body: Your agent stays ready between messages, so the next one starts at once instead of after a few seconds.

changes.title: The iPhone app and Ensemble Cloud
changes.body: With them go the inbox, online mode and thread summaries; Ensemble runs threads on your computer and in cloud sandboxes.

changes.title: Threads on your own servers over SSH
Helper chats and sub-threads
changes.body: With notes between threads, combining threads, the Lead and the autonomy setting. Side chats and to-dos stay.

changes.title: See what's new in every version
changes.body: In Settings › What's new, and in the update popup.

changes.title: Start a thread from another thread's work or a branch
New thread opens as a page of its own
A cleaner light theme
An agent can fix a service that fails to start
changes.body: Send its error from the Running tab and the agent fixes the cause.

changes.title: A thread archives itself once its pull request merges
changes.body: Turn it off in Settings › Labs.

changes.title: Faster starts after an update
macOS no longer autocorrects what you type to the agent
Betas too works on Linux and Windows
Get new versions early
changes.body: Settings › General › Updates: choose Betas too to get each new version before everyone else.

changes.title: The app opens again after updating
changes.body: Some conversations made 0.2.8's window break as soon as it opened.

changes.title: No more crashes when a thread starts or stops working
changes.body: And if the window does break, it offers the update that fixes it.

changes.title: Stacked pull requests
changes.body: A thread can build on another's branch; its pull request merges after it.

changes.title: See when each usage limit resets
changes.body: The usage popover shows each agent's limits, when they reset, and whether you're on pace.

changes.title: Choose which logins to use, and when to switch
changes.body: In Settings › Agents, turn logins on or off and set the order they're used in.

changes.title: Updates never cut a running turn off
changes.body: Your machines update quietly in the background, and agents carry on where they were.

changes.title: Agents answer with pages of data
changes.body: Numbers, charts, tables, timelines and flows, drawn right in the reply in the app's own style.

changes.title: Agents can point you to another thread
changes.body: It shows as a chip you can click to open it.

changes.title: Ensemble VMs run folder projects
Code blocks with highlighting and a copy button
Ensemble for Windows
changes.body: Download the installer from the website.

changes.title: Merge conflicts go to the agent
changes.body: Press Merge on a pull request that conflicts, and the agent merges the base in for you.

changes.title: Check for updates from Settings
Dictate your messages
changes.body: Speak into the message box on a Mac, with Apple's speech recognition.

changes.title: Attach any file to a message
changes.body: Up to 5 MB each.

changes.title: Move a thread to a bigger VM
changes.body: From the move menu, or ask the agent when a build needs more room.

changes.title: Get started suggests your projects
changes.body: The repositories Claude Code and Codex have worked in are offered as projects.

changes.title: Take over a thread an agent started
changes.body: Threads an agent starts report to it, until you take one over.

changes.title: See when an update is ready
changes.body: Above the sidebar's foot, with a restart button.

changes.title: Archiving a thread with an open pull request asks first
Ensemble's first release
changes.body: Run Claude Code and Codex threads side by side, each in a machine of its own, on your Mac or your own servers.
